clauses.clause: Historian of Zhalfir {2}{U}{U} Creature — Human Wizard 3/3 (cast)
clauses.evidence: [cast]: hand -> stack -> battlefield, P/T 3/3, mana C-2 U-2.

clauses.clause: Whenever this creature attacks, if you control a Teferi planeswalker, draw a card.
clauses.evidence: The standard board has no Teferi: 'this creature attacks alone, unblocked' and 'attacks and opp_giant blocks it' show no trigger and no draw, and the draw itself is never in the trace. Packs J11_1 (Teferi, Master of Time: one card), J11_2 (another planeswalker), J11_3 (the opponent's Teferi), J11_4 (a creature named Teferi), J11_5 (another creature attacks), J11_6 (two Teferis: one card), J11_7 (the Teferi leaves in response: no card).
